6.95 rsInvalidParameterNameNotCLSCompliant
rsInvalidParameterNameNotCLSCompliant is a critical error that will occur when a Subreport contains
a Parameters.Parameter element that has a Name attribute whose value is not CLS-compliant
[UTR15].
